_comment: Wave 2 -- full Cartesian product over the only dial wave 1 found that wins, crossed with the two things it might interact with. 7 horizons x 4 item sets x 2 slot policies = 56 cells, each played against a mirror AND against four wrapped ladder recordings. The panel condition is the point: the donor's front-run only fires when its mirror detector is confident (_CLONE_CONFIDENCE >= 2), so a 28-point mirror win may be an artefact of self-play and vanish against anything that does not look like us.
_wave1_result: F.fr_3 78.7% [75.0, 82.0] and F.fr_6 77.7% against a byte-identical opponent; F.fr_off 22.9%. Turning the donor's front-run off costs 56 points. Every arm that dumped or hoarded supply lost, and made the opponent RICHER: C.fr_straw -$8,706 for us, +$9,608 for them.

_notes.why_base_price_and_glut_weight_travel_wi: _front_run indexes _GLUT_WEIGHT[item] and _BASE_PRICE[item] directly, and both dicts hold only the four premium products. Widening _FRONT_RUN_ITEMS alone raises KeyError inside _base_agent, which is called OUTSIDE the donor's try/except -- the exception escapes the agent entirely rather than degrading to a no-op. The all9 level therefore carries all three constants. Neutral weight 1.0 on the five added products keeps this a pure widening of the set rather than a re-weighting.
_notes.h0_is_a_replicate: h0 turns the front-run off, so its eight cells differ only in dials that then do nothing. They should all land on the same number; if they do not, the run has a variance problem the intervals are understating.
_notes.the_question_this_wave_actually_asks: Wave 1 measured a mirror. The clone detector compares public farm signatures and only fires at distance <= 1, which self-play satisfies by construction and a real opponent may never. If the effect survives against agents/wrapped/*, it is a market mechanism. If it collapses to 50%, it is a self-play artefact and nothing here transfers to the ladder.
